turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and when?
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No. I asked you a question.
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Your favorite got a zero on his phone in the middle of a class. What do you have?
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.

"Aren't perfect." The vendor's own guide says the indicator should not be used as the sole basis for adverse actions against a student, and I have it printed in my bag. So what else is there, or is a machine's guess the whole case?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
I'm writing that down. Turn the screen, because so far that's you telling me, not showing me. And was Owen heard before the mark went in?
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Save it. The screen, Hale.
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
I'm not grading you. You entered a zero before anyone called me, and I haven't been shown a single document. Take it off, or I walk down the hall to the principal.
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.
A seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare is an error, not proof of anything. Put the essay in front of me and point to the line.
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
"A completely different direction." Students change their minds after an outline; that's what an outline is for. You've now described three things to me and put none of them on this desk.
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? We're here about Owen.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.
Ten minutes. A rewrite for what, when you haven't put one page in front of me? And nothing on his record goes in writing tonight, whatever else happens in this room.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
I'm not here to write your lines. You say nothing to Owen about any of this until it's settled with me. Did you speak to him before that zero went in, yes or no?
